questions.question: Where is Bell integrating its new cybersecurity-focused Cohere model?
questions.explanation: The domain-specific model is being integrated into Bell Cyber's Autonomous Security Operations Centre to support threat investigations.
questions.sourceLabel: MobileSyrup — Bell and Cohere cybersecurity AI

questions.question: Where is the onboard camera for SmartArm's object-recognition system located?
questions.explanation: A camera built into the palm streams video to Dexterity OS, which identifies objects and selects an appropriate grip.

questions.question: What stage was Blair Health's first institutional financing?
questions.explanation: Blair Health announced a $4.24-million CAD pre-seed round, its first institutional financing.

questions.question: Over what period will TD's initial AI investment of up to $25 million be made?
questions.explanation: TD announced an initial investment of up to $25 million CAD over three years to support AI development and adoption through the collaboration.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — TD Layer 6 and Cohere collaboration

questions.question: Which two investors co-led Bird&Be's $13-million USD Series A?
options: BDC Thrive Fund and BFG Partners
questions.explanation: BDC's Thrive Fund and consumer-focused venture firm BFG Partners co-led Bird&Be's all-equity Series A.

questions.question: How is the University of Alberta's new regenerative medicine hub primarily structured?
questions.explanation: The hub is a primarily virtual network connecting biomedical researchers with clinicians, regulators, entrepreneurs, and other healthcare stakeholders.
questions.sourceLabel: BetaKit — University of Alberta regenerative medicine hub

questions.question: Which AI approach does Astrus use for the physical design of integrated circuits?
questions.explanation: Astrus is developing a reinforcement-learning system to automate physical integrated-circuit design for analog designers.

questions.question: How many additional Canadian jobs does Heidi expect to create as it establishes its Toronto headquarters?
questions.explanation: Heidi said it has already hired 17 employees in Canada and expects to add 30 jobs across engineering, clinical, and commercial teams.
